description_en: Invite a SIP device to join a channel
kebab_example: aliyun rtc rtc-sip-invite-member --app-id eo850000 --channel-id rtc_channelid --uid rtc_userid --device-type phone --registered false --sip-display-name testdevice --sip-user-id reg_userid --sip-room-id 18512514528 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RtcSipInviteMember

parameters.help_en: Application ID. Get it from the console. Pass one ID only
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: Channel ID. Pass one ID only
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
Device type of the third-party SIP system:

sip_device

mcu

phone

Note: Only phone is supported at this time
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫第三方sip的设备类型：
sip_device
mcu
phone

备注：当前阶段，仅支持phone类型
parameters.name: device_type

parameters.help_en:
IP address of the nearest RTC SIP server.

Resolve the domain name rtcsip.dingtalk.com locally to get the nearest address. For example, run dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com
parameters.help_zh:
就近接入 rtc sip 服务器IP地址。
用户通过本地进行解析域名:rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取到就近接入地址。
如: dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取
parameters.name: server_address

parameters.help_en: Token required to join the meeting. For sample code, see the referenced document
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: Whether the third-party conferencing system must register before receiving the call
parameters.help_zh: 第三方会议系统是否要注册呼入
parameters.name: registered

parameters.help_en: Name displayed for the user on the third-party system
parameters.name: sip_display_name

parameters.help_en:
If DeviceType is mcu, this is the third-party conferencing system.

If DeviceType is sip_device, this is the registered device.

If the third-party system requires registration, use the account provided by that system.

If no registration is required, use the SIP username (RTC user ID)
parameters.help_zh:
当DeviceType = mcu ，代表第三方会议系统
当DeviceType = sip_device  代表注册设备
如果第三方会议系统要求注册呼入，则为第三方系统提供的注册账号
如果不需要注册呼叫，则为呼入第三方的sip用户名rtc userid
parameters.name: sip_user_id

parameters.help_en: The registration password for the SipUserId. This parameter is required when a third party registers to receive incoming calls
parameters.help_zh: 如果第三方要注册呼入，匹配SipUserId的注册密码
parameters.name: sip_user_password

parameters.help_en:
If the device is an MCU, this is the channel number of the third-party conferencing system.

If the device is a SIP device, this is the registration number of the device to invite.

If the device is a phone, this is the called phone number
parameters.help_zh:
当设备是mcu时，表示呼入的第三方会议系统的频道号码
当设备是sip_device时，表示要邀请的注册设备的注册号码
当设备是phone时，表示被叫的电话号码
parameters.name: sip_room_id

parameters.help_en:
If the device is an MCU, this is the IP address and port of the third-party conferencing system in the format ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls. Example: 30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp.

If the device is a SIP device, this is the registration address of the device to invite. Example: 39.101.232.13.

If the device is a phone, this is the address of the PSTN gateway. Example: 30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp
parameters.help_zh:
当设备是mcu 表示第三方会议系统的地址信息ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
当设备是sip_device 表示要邀请的注册设备的注册地址
如: 39.101.232.13
当设备是phone 表示电话网关的地址信息
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
parameters.name: sip_uri

parameters.help_en: Brand or model of the third-party SIP device. Examples: polycom, cisco, tencent, zoom, pstn
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫第三方sip的品牌型号 如polycom/cisco/tencent/zoom/pstn
parameters.name: sip_user_agent

parameters.help_en: Custom line number for PSTN calls
parameters.help_zh: pstn场景下自定义线路号码
parameters.name: call_number
